description: This file defines a graphical application that initializes a window, draws colored rectangles for a list of colors, and displays the color names. It manages drawing iterations with an offset to animate or update the display.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window and sets size and margin parameters.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the background, color rectangles, and labels; updates the animation offset.
